messages:
Maria G: FYI hitting provisioning failures when spinning up NVv4 pool in UK West for the inference lab. Azure API returns quota error.
Jamie L: error snippet?
Maria G: here's the API error when allocating 8x NV48as_v4
```
ClientError: AllocationFailed - QuotaExceeded: Requested core quota (48) exceeds limit for region UK West (current: 32)
Resource: /subscriptions/XXX/resourceGroups/rg-inference
```
Kevin S: ah, NVv4 quotas are separate from standard GPU SKUs. Did we file a support case yet?
Maria G: opened one with Azure portal, case 2100123456. assigned engineer: Sarah T. Support says backend approval needed for accelerated-networking NIC-per-vm increase.
Azure Support Bot: Case 2100123456 - New response from Azure: "We're reviewing your quota request for NV48as_v4 cores and NICs in UK West. ETA 72 hours unless escalated." (link: https://portal.azure.com/#blade/Microsoft_Azure_Support/HelpAndSupportBlade/overview)
Jamie L: 72h is too slow for the lab day tomorrow. Can someone escalate via our Premier contract?
Ops Oncall: @Kevin S can you ping AM and request escalation? I can open a concurrent internal ticket with infra-squad for workaround.
Kevin S: pinged AM (cc: Amanda). Also opened internal ticket INF-3421. Suggested temporary workaround: deploy split smaller VMs (NV12as_v4) across multiple nodes and stitch cluster — but that increases networking overhead and cost.
Maria G: cost estimate for split nodes vs waiting: running 4x NV12as_v4 for same capacity is ~1.6x base cost due to extra VMs and cross-az traffic. We should get approval before spinning.
Jamie L: if AM can't escalate, we could try requesting AVD (accelerated VM deployment) quota bypass — Sarah mentioned we can attach a justification and customer reference id. Kevin, can you share usage justification text?
Kevin S: Drafted justification and uploaded to case 2100123456. Text: "Redwood Inference dev cluster for performance tests and capacity smoke tests. Non-production, low risk. Need temporary increase to validate autoscaler behavior and model performance. Will revert to baseline after 7 days." Will also add billing contact.
Maria G: also flagged that NIC-per-vm limit is blocking provisioning of NV48as_v4 (need 8 NICs) — Azure quoting NIC limit 4 for our subscription in that region.
Ops Oncall: quick workaround plan in INF-3421: (1) create 2 smaller node pools in UK West across two availability zones, (2) pre-warm caches on existing host, (3) run reduced-concurrency tests. Not ideal but should let the team test models.
Jamie L: can we request burst capacity in another region (UK South) while UK West is pending? That avoids cross-region AM escalation.
Kevin S: opened a parallel case 2100123460 for UK South NVv4 cores. Azure support: "UK South currently has capacity but quota needs to be raised, estimate 24-48h". Case link in portal.
Maria G: please add tags to both cases: "critical-lab", "dev-queue", and mention circuit-breaker fallback for production is not affected.
Ops Oncall: noted. INF-3421 updated with both Azure case numbers and internal runbook steps. Attaching the minimal helm chart change to disable single-node constraint:
```
# helm values override
nodeSelector:
  inference.redwood.com/skew: split
replicaCount: 4
```
Kevin S: AM replied: escalation request submitted to Azure field team, CC'd Sarah T. They said if we provide example subscription IDs and expected end date (we put 7 days) they can push to regional capacity team.
Jamie L: can someone confirm expected date and owner to close this? I can own followups if oncall is busy.
Maria G: I'll track provisioning once escalation returns. Owner: Jamie. Target revert date: 2026-03-25 (7 days)
Ops Oncall: adding reminder: @Jamie please post final state in #eng-infra and tag product if we hit cost delta > $500 for the workaround.
Jamie L: will do. any other blockers?
Maria G: blocker is Azure NIC and NVv4 core quotas. All other infra green.
Azure Support Bot: Case 2100123456 updated: "Field team requested additional verification. Please provide sample ARM template and subscription ID."
Kevin S: uploaded ARM template to the case and added our subscription: sub-0a1b2c3d. Also included a short perf plan.
Maria G: thanks. I'll attempt a dry-run deploy to UK South once the second case is approved.
Jamie L: thanks all. :thumbsup:
Ops Oncall: closing internal incident note for now, will reopen if Azure response ETA slips beyond 48h.
